Job Description

About us statworx is a leading Data & AI Consulting and Development company in the DACH region. For more than a decade, we have been helping organizations succeed with consulting, development, and training – delivering over 1,000 successful projects for more than 100 clients across nearly every industry. From AI strategy to implementation, we develop innovative solutions. With expertise in AI Strategy, Generative AI, Agentic AI, Data & AI Engineering, and AI Infrastructure, we support organizations throughout their entire AI transformation journey. Our goal: Creating value from Data & AI. Our AI Development department serves as a facilitator for Data & AI transformation. We are taking a holistic approach, from the initial evaluation of AI maturity, through the design and development of data and AI solutions, to the practical implementation and scaling of AI solutions. Through our deep expertise in Data Engineering, Data Science, Machine Learning, we ensure that our clients gain the maximum value from their data.
